commit.message:
Enhance PlatformStatsScreen and SetTimerScreen Functionality

- Refactored PlatformStatsScreen to utilize useFocusEffect for loading platform stats and refreshing timer settings.
- Introduced a new refreshLimitMinutes function to load timer settings from the database.
- Updated SetTimerScreen to save timer settings and update overlay configuration upon slider change.
- Improved UI elements for better user feedback on timer saving status.

Add Platform Stats and Navigation Updates

- Introduced a new tab navigation structure with MainTabs for Home and Stats screens.
- Added PlatformStatsScreen to display usage statistics for Instagram and YouTube.
- Implemented CircularProgress and PlatformCard components for visual representation of platform usage.
- Updated database schema to include platform-specific daily stats.
- Enhanced ContentMonitorService to track user engagement on Instagram and YouTube.
- Updated various screens and components for improved UI and functionality, including adjustments to padding and layout.
- Added new icons for Instagram and YouTube Shorts.

Implement Content Monitoring Feature

- Renamed ReelsMonitorService to ContentMonitorService in AndroidManifest.xml.
- Added ContentMonitorModule for managing content monitoring functionalities.
- Created ContentMonitorPackage to register the new module.
- Introduced ContentMonitorService to handle accessibility events and track user engagement on Instagram and YouTube.
- Implemented methods for permission checks and overlay management.

Update README with Google Play link

Added Google Play link for the Detoxie app.
